result.instructions: Tools for Rossum, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which documents are waiting for review in our invoice queue?"; "Show the extracted invoice number and total for annotation 4821."; "What is blocking automation on the purchase order queue?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rossum data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rossum_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rossum_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rossum_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rossum_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rossum_get_current_user

tools.description: The Rossum user this connection signs in as, with its organization and roles. Rossum API: GET /api/v1/auth/user.

tools.name: rossum_search_annotations
tools.title: Search annotations
tools.description: Search annotations with a MongoDB-style query object (for example {"status": "to_review"}) or a query_string. Search results can lag a few seconds behind changes. Rossum API: POST /api/v1/annotations/search (read only).

query.description: A MongoDB-style filter object, for example {"status": "to_review"}.

query_string.description: A full-text search over extracted values (at least 2 characters). Combined with query by AND.

ordering.description: Sort field, for example -modified_at (a leading minus sorts descending).

search_after.description: The search_after query value from pagination.next of the previous search reply. Copy only that value; do not build it.
